name: io.github.meador793/stats-explorer-mcp
title: Stats Explorer
description: Verified statistics for AI agents: guided hypothesis tests, confirmed choices, charts, reports.

environmentVariables.name: STATS_EXPLORER_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders the tools may read data files from and write reports to (separated by : on macOS/Linux, ; on Windows). Defaults to the client's workspace roots, or the current directory.

environmentVariables.name: STATS_EXPLORER_GUIDED
environmentVariables.description: on (default): classify each request and follow the six-step workflow for hypothesis tests. off: expose the individual test tools directly.

environmentVariables.name: STATS_EXPLORER_CONFIRM_SELECTIONS
environmentVariables.description: on (default): the user confirms every column, chart type and report section before anything runs. off: run with the AI's choices.

environmentVariables.name: STATS_EXPLORER_HIDE_LINK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to remove the one-line Stats Explorer app link from results.
